description: Force diff-grounding in the codex reviewer path by injecting git diff main...HEAD into the reviewer's model_instructions_file so codex reviews the real changeset instead of confabulating.

userStories.title: Inject git diff main...HEAD into the codex reviewer instructions
userStories.description: As the cam supervisor dispatching a codex reviewer, I need the actual branch diff physically injected into the codex reviewer prompt so that codex reviews the real changeset under review instead of pattern-matching repo context and confabulating a confident CLEAN verdict about code it never looked at.
acceptanceCriteria: The codex reviewer dispatch (CodexAdapter.buildSpawnArgv('reviewer', ...)) physically includes the actual `git diff main...HEAD` output plus the changed-file name list, computed at dispatch time, in the content passed to codex; injection is into the model_instructions_file body (or a sibling /tmp file codex is told to read), NOT the shell-escaped argv prompt, to avoid ARG_MAX blowups on large diffs. [oracle: grep -q 'model_instructions_file' src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts]
The injected reviewer content carries an explicit directive to review ONLY the injected diff (the current branch's changes vs main), not repo context or history. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

The three-dot form `git diff main...HEAD` (branch changes since the merge-base with main) is used, and the base ref name resolution ('main') is robust (not a hardcoded assumption that crashes when the ref is missing). [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'main\.\.\.HEAD' src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts]
When the branch has no diff vs main, the injected content is a well-formed no-changes marker (never a crash, never an empty-string ambiguity). [oracle: named-command bun test]
Any large-diff cap (if implemented) is visible via a truncation marker, never a silent cut. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Injection is scoped to the codex reviewer actor ONLY; the codex implementer, planner, and auditor render paths are unchanged (no diff injected for them). [oracle: named-command bun test]

The ClaudeAdapter rendered argv for reviewer, implementer, planner, and auditor is byte-identical to before this slice; a test asserts the claude reviewer argv is unchanged (the existing golden characterization test in test/supervisor/backend-adapter.test.ts still passes verbatim). [oracle: named-command bun test test/supervisor/backend-adapter.test.ts]

A test against a REAL fixture git repo with a known diff (a real tmpdir git init + main branch + a feature branch with a known change) asserts the rendered codex reviewer instructions contain the injected diff content; this hits the real git boundary, not a fake. [oracle: named-command bun test test/supervisor/codex-adapter.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint/static spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Single-file fix: src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts (CodexAdapter.renderActor ~438 and the 'reviewer' case ~427; writeCodexInstructionsFile ~370; REVIEWER_TASK_PROMPT ~127). Tests: extend test/supervisor/codex-adapter.test.ts (add the real-fixture-git-repo diff-injection test + the reviewer-only scoping assertion) and keep test/supervisor/backend-adapter.test.ts golden untouched to prove ClaudeAdapter byte-identity. DO NOT touch the ClaudeAdapter branch, worker-argv.ts, plan-argv.ts, or review.ts rendering: ADR-0047 fixes the one-way fan-out (those import FROM backend-adapter.ts). The claude reviewer self-grounds via its Bash `git diff`, so this slice is codex-only (ADR-0047 mismatch d: codex has no --agent harness that forces grounding steps). Design guidance: extend writeCodexInstructionsFile (or add a helper) to accept an optional appended diff block; append the diff to the instructions-file BODY, not the argv prompt (gotcha: prompt is one argv token subject to ARG_MAX). Compute the diff via a real git subprocess following the repo convention (spawnSync 'git' with a `-C <cwd>` arg, as in src/commands/status.ts:387 and src/commands/tag.ts): use `git diff main...HEAD` + `git diff --name-only main...HEAD`. For testability against a real tmp git repo, thread a cwd (or an injectable git-diff provider) so the fixture test can point at the tmpdir; keep selectAdapter's `new CodexAdapter()` default-constructed (no behavior change for production). Bun-only: prefer Bun.spawnSync/spawnSync git per the point-read carve-out already used across src/commands. noUncheckedIndexedAccess: guard spawnSync stdout/regex captures. Related pattern (patterns.md line ~104/108/134): the reviewer's structured output flows via review-report.json; this story does not change that channel, only what codex is fed as input. ADR-0047 is the design record for the adapter seam; re-read its mismatch-d section before coding. Live evidence in the issue body: codex wrote a schema-valid CLEAN review of the already-merged cam/issue-352 with fabricated Layer-B oracle PASS lines while the real branch diff was a 4-line doc.
